# response_kernels.txt — single-photon impulse responses of the two readout
# chains of the August 2026 T10 electronics card, one line per 0.2 ns sample.
#
#   column 1  t (ns) after the photon's arrival at the silicon photomultiplier
#   column 2  h_HG(t)  high-gain (timing) chain, amplitude per unit-area photon
#   column 3  h_LG(t)  low-gain (energy) chain, amplitude per unit-area photon
#
# PROVENANCE (2026-09-14, scratch macro jointfit.C): one shared electronics
# model was fitted jointly with a free two-component light model per material
# to the measured mean tagged-electron pulse shapes of runs 33 (DSB1), 27 (LuAG)
# and 42 (EJ199), all 7 GeV, high-gain and low-gain chains, 970 samples each.
#   high gain: CR-RC shaper, both time constants 2.88 ns, then AC coupling 58 ns
#   low gain:  shaper exp(-t/83.7) - exp(-t/16.6) ns, no AC coupling (>10 us),
#              low-gain chain 2.0 ns EARLIER than the high-gain chain
#   fitted light (data): DSB1 39% prompt + 33 ns; LuAG 26% prompt + 56 ns;
#                        EJ199 32% prompt + 30 ns   (two-component model)
#   residuals: 0.05-0.07 of peak (high gain), 0.02 (low gain)
# The model assumes every slow tail is LIGHT, not electronics (a slow tail in
# the impulse response is degenerate with slow light in mean-shape data and was
# fixed to zero). Absolute gains (ADC-eq per photon) are NOT in this file: the
# emulation macro calibrates them on the DSB1 5 GeV point.
